parole.significato: The rearing and care of horses.
parole.testo: From Latin equus (“horse”) + cultura (“cultivation”); stem equus from Proto-Italic *ekwos, from Proto-Indo-European *h₁éḱwos (“horse”).

parole.significato: The rearing and care of sheep.
parole.testo: From Latin ovis (“sheep”) + cultura (“cultivation”); stem ovis from Proto-Italic *owis, from Proto-Indo-European *h₂ówis. By surface analysis, ovi- + culture.

parole.significato: A large drinking cup, often having a stem and base and used especially for formal occasions and religious ceremonies.
